offering_description.value: Sells cinema, digital and digital out-of-home advertising to brands and marketers. It delivers cinema campaigns through a nationwide network of national and regional theater chains.

quotes.quote: National CineMedia (NCM) is the largest cinema advertising platform in the US. With unparalleled reach and scale, we connect brands to young, diverse audiences through the power of movies and pop culture. A premium video, full-funnel marketing solution for advertisers, NCM enhances marketers' ability to measure and drive results. NCM’s leading preshow, The Noovie® Show is presented exclusively in 42 leading national and regional theater circuits – including the only three national chains: AMC Entertainment Inc., Cinemark Holdings, Inc. and Regal Entertainment Group. NCM’s cinema platform consists of 17,500+ screens in more than 1,350 theaters in 184 Designated Market Areas® (all of the Top 50).
NCM is a movie theater advertising company that offers local, regional, and national opportunities at several top theaters in the U.S. as well as digital and digital out-of-home platforms.
